newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits narrowly mixed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits narrowly mixed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were narrowly mixed in moderate trade on Monday with most traders sidelined due mainly to the absence of fresh incentives, dealers said.
"Rates were narrowly mixed in the morning on some position adjustments. But most traders were reluctant to open or hold new positions," a local dealer said.

"Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from Tuesday's release of the (U.S. June) retail sales figures, but unless the figures are off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday and Tuesday/Wednesday were unchanged from last Friday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, respectively.
Week-fixed rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
Among longe dates, one-months eased 1/16 point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent and three-months eased 1/16 point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
Nine-months was unchanged from last Friday's 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent.
